excerpts.content:
There isn't a separate channel for ERCs.  
Assuming there are no formatting issues for you to fix, you just need to wait for an ERC editor to review your ERC (I am not an ERC editor).

You could also try attending office hours:
https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/359
